name: Truck Simulator: Heavy Cargo Offroad
summary:
Truck Simulator: Heavy Cargo Offroad puts you behind the wheel of heavy-duty trucks in a realistic Offroad Truck Simulator built for VR driving, cargo transport, & delivery missions. Experience Truck Simulator gameplay with cargo truck handling, heavy cargo routes, trailers, & offroad driving across steep hills, narrow roads, & rough terrain

From jungle trails & desert tracks to snowy mountains, every route tests your truck driving skills, balance, precision, & control. Transport heavy cargo such as sand,
